# Friends Tax Point

> Friends Tax Point is a tax and business consultancy in Kerala, India, serving individuals, farmers, freelancers and businesses since 2001. It has 7 branches across Kollam, Thiruvananthapuram and Pathanamthitta districts.

## Key facts
- Name: Friends Tax Point
- Type: Tax & business consultants (accounting service)
- Founded: 2001
- Region served: Kerala, India (Kollam, Thiruvananthapuram, Pathanamthitta)
- Senior Tax Consultant: Liju Nellickal
- Phone: +91 70129 69190, +91 85479 73534
- Email: lijunellickal@gmail.com
- Website: https://friendstaxpoint.com/
- Clients served: 500+; client retention 98%; typical response time under 24 hours

## Services
- Income Tax Return (ITR) filing and PAN card services
- GST registration, GST returns (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B), annual returns and reconciliation
- TDS / TCS returns, Form 16 and 16A
- Digital Signature Certificates (Class 3 DSC)
- E-way bill generation and e-invoicing
- Business registration: proprietorship, partnership, LLP, private limited company
- Partnership deeds, license registration and project reports
- Accounting and bookkeeping
- Tax planning and Income Tax / GST notice handling
- Rubber Board returns and agricultural subsidy management for rubber planters and farmers
- Vehicle and health insurance

## Branches
- Anchal — Kuruvikonam (Kollam district)
- Venchempu — Pinacle Point (Kollam district)
- Kilimanoor — Central Junction (Thiruvananthapuram district)
- Ayoor — near KSRTC bus stand (Kollam district)
- Pathanapuram — Puthuval (Kollam district)
- Ranni — near KSRTC bus stand (Pathanamthitta district)
- Enath — K.J. Building (Pathanamthitta district)

## Frequently asked questions
- How long does ITR filing take? Most returns are filed within 24 hours of receiving complete documents.
- Can I file without visiting? Yes — documents can be shared by phone or email.
- Is agricultural income taxable? Generally exempt in India, but it must be reported correctly in the return; Friends Tax Point helps planters do this and claim subsidies.
- Do you help with tax notices? Yes, for both Income Tax and GST notices.
